main_text.l: Examen Vindiciarum quas Antitrinitarii Hæretici, qui se Remonstrantium nomine tegunt, & Orthodoxam doctrinam de S.S. Trinitate simulant, illi Parti opposuerunt.
S. S. Theol. Doctore & Professore in illustri Gymnasio DAVENTRIENSI.
Apud FRANCISCUM HEGERUM, è regione Academiæ.

page.notes: The emblem is an engraving: a banner reading "VIVIMUS EX UNO" above a bird (eagle-like figure) with young beside it; not transcribed as text. The date line is printed in Roman-numeral form with reversed C/D forms (cIↄ Iↄ c xxxıv); read as MDCXXXV, which is uncertain: [?]. The imprint's "Academiæ" is partly obscured and may read differently.
